boundary: zero model, GPU, tool, embedding and network contacts. Every number is computed from outputs JSONL files that prior, separately-registered runs already sealed; gold enters only through the registered official scorer, on split_id='devel' with allow_heldout=False. No SLURP devel sentence text is read. The held-out test split is never named, loaded or scored.

kc_s1b_fallback_rows.note: forward looking only: KC-S1b chose its per-intent TRAIN slot schema block from the SEALED closed-list response, so this says what a successor cell would have served, never what KC-S1b did serve. No KC-S1b number is restated because of it.

lock.rule: re-lock as closed-list + projection iff the intent delta is >= 0 on BOTH OLD500 and NEW500 and no gold-scenario stratum is harmed on intent by more than 1 row

KU-S1C-DRAFT.note: the draft phase's own sealed responses, read from the flight's phases file and scored through the same registered scorer functions over the same complete 1,000 rows; no manifest exists for a phase, so core.scoring_batch cannot reach it (registered in advance)

CLOSED-LIST.definition: among the rows the REGISTERED projection changed: 'exchange' counts those whose parsed pair becomes legal with its halves swapped; 'action_as_scenario' counts those whose parsed scenario is not a legal scenario but IS a legal action name, and the promotion columns price what sending it back to its owning scenario would have recovered. Descriptive only -- no rule, no metric, no gate, no effect on the lock decision.
